name: Python Gravel Vacuum Siphon
description: A wide-mouth gravel-vacuum siphon — the tool driven by Stage 15's renderer SiphonTool (the cleaner reuses it, no fork). It vacuums settled waste / detritus out of the substrate during a water change and lightly lifts diatom film sitting on the floor. removesWaste is true — it ties into the Stage 13 chemistry waste / detritus. effectiveness (0.7) + reachMm (50) are MODELLED game-tuning weights, not product specs.
notes: Hover the mouth over gravel — debris lifts, gravel drops back. Don't dig deep into a planted aquasoil bed (it pulls up substrate + uproots carpets); use it over open sand / gravel.
